Test Steps: Enter registered email and correct password. Submit.
Expected Result: Redirect to dashboard. Session cookie set with Secure and HttpOnly flags.

Test Steps: Enter registered email and an incorrect password. Submit.
Expected Result: Generic failure message. Response must not reveal whether the email exists. No session created.

Precondition: Active account, lockout threshold set to 5
Test Steps: Submit an incorrect password five consecutive times.
Expected Result: Sixth attempt is rejected regardless of password correctness. Lockout notice sent to the account email.

Summary: Session expiry during an idle period
Test Steps: Sign in, leave the tab idle past the timeout, then trigger an authenticated action.
Expected Result: Action rejected, user returned to sign-in with the destination preserved. No unhandled error.

Summary: First charge with a valid card
Precondition: New account, no stored payment method, sandbox processor
Test Steps: Select the monthly plan, enter a valid test card, confirm.
Expected Result: Charge succeeds. Subscription active. Receipt email sent. Ledger webhook delivered exactly once.

Test Steps: Select the monthly plan, enter the decline test card, confirm.
Expected Result: Clear decline message with the processor reason. No subscription created. No partial account state left behind.

Summary: Double submission of the payment form
Test Steps: Submit the payment form, then submit again before the first response returns.
Expected Result: Exactly one charge. Second submission is idempotent, not a second authorization.

Summary: Card expiring before the next renewal
Precondition: Active subscription, stored card expiring within the billing period
Test Steps: Advance the clock to the renewal date in the time-shifted environment.
Expected Result: Renewal attempt fails cleanly, dunning sequence starts, account not suspended before the retry window closes.

Summary: Card expiry in the past is rejected before submission
Precondition: New account, valid test card number
Test Steps: Enter a valid test card number and an expiry date in the past, for example 01/22. Confirm.
Expected Result: Inline error shown for the expiry. No request is sent to the payment API.

Precondition: Active monthly subscription, 12 days into a 30-day period
Test Steps: Change to the higher-tier plan and confirm.
Expected Result: Prorated charge matches the finance-supplied expected value to the cent. New tier effective immediately.

Test Steps: Change to the lower-tier plan and confirm.
Expected Result: No immediate charge or refund. Current tier retained until period end. Scheduled change recorded with its effective date.

Precondition: Active monthly subscription, 12 days into a 31-day period
Test Steps: Change to the higher-tier plan and confirm.
Expected Result: Prorated charge uses the real period length and matches the finance-supplied expected value to the cent.

Test Steps: Replay an identical payment-succeeded event twice.
Expected Result: Ledger records one entry. Duplicate acknowledged, not reprocessed.

Test Steps: Deliver an event with a missing required field.
Expected Result: Rejected with a 4xx and logged with the event ID. No partial write. No retry storm.
